test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six girls, Pooja, Qimat, Reeti, Shweta, Tejaswini and Vineeta, are sitting around a circular table. All of them are facing towards the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). Tejaswini is the immediate neighbour of Vineeta and Reeti. Pooja is to the immediate left of Vineeta. Qimat is fourth to the right of Pooja. Shweta is to the immediate left of Pooja.Who is sitting to the immediate left of Shweta?.
solution:
Given: Six girls, Pooja, Qimat, Reeti, Shweta, Tejaswini and Vineeta. 

1) Pooja is to the immediate left of Vineeta.

2) Shweta is to the immediate left of Pooja.

3) Qimat is fourth to the right of Pooja.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41451a9877418be6551f39d0342f7a0294f9826a90e43efcd0237d6fe2169e7c.png] 

4) Tejaswini is the immediate neighbour of Vineeta and Reeti. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6400510fbcbc269347fb5abc6cbe06c568c4863ac28e94e66d601a585af392.png] 

So, Qimat is sitting to the immediate left of Shweta.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Qimat"**.
